content.cast.the-crank.wren.0.bark.0: 雷恩在大门外面，太远了，听不见。
content.cast.the-watch.wren.0.bark.0: 雷恩在大门外面，太远了，听不见。
content.class.caller.blurb: 为瞭望塔准备：望远镜观察各条小径；用鸡蛋和弓把沉睡者从朋友身边引开。
content.class.caller.name: 呼叫者
content.class.runner.blurb: 轻快的脚步适合小径：向远处的大门跑，花园安静下来时就潜行。
content.class.runner.kit.1.name: 软底靴
content.class.runner.name: 奔跑者
content.dlg.wren.wren-alone.opt.0.label: 那是什么东西？
content.dlg.wren.wren-alone.opt.1.label: 我等他们。
content.dlg.wren.wren-alone.opt.2.label: 今晚就我一个。
content.dlg.wren.wren-alone.text: 哎呀！你出来了！我把门绞上的时候，你还在里面，是不是？真对不起。里面还有别人吗？要是有人在瞭望塔上，桥现在升起来了：只要胆子够大，就能从迷宫顶上走过来。
content.dlg.wren.wren-thing-alone.opt.0.label: 我等他们。
content.dlg.wren.wren-thing-alone.opt.1.label: 今晚就我一个。
content.dlg.wren.wren-thing-alone.text: 聆听者。它睡在老井下面，能听见迷宫里每一声脚步。我们园丁走路很轻，黄昏时把门绞上，它就一直睡着。今晚它没睡。
content.dlg.wren.wren-thing.opt.0.label: 我们出来了。
content.dlg.wren.wren-thing.text: 聆听者。它睡在老井下面，能听见迷宫里每一声脚步。我们园丁走路很轻，黄昏时把门绞上，它就一直睡着。今晚它没睡。明天我还要在大门上挂个铃铛。
content.dlg.wren.wren-together.opt.0.label: 那是什么东西？
content.dlg.wren.wren-together.opt.1.label: 我们出来了。
content.dlg.wren.wren-together.text: 哎呀！哎呀，你们两个都出来了！我把门绞上的时候，你们还在里面，是不是？你们是从桥上过来的？那座桥三十个夏天没人走过了。真对不起。光是看你们过桥，我就提心吊胆的。
content.fx.locked-in.oc.take-the-note.0.narrate: “打烊了！大门绞上了。如果你看到这张字条，说明你被锁在里面了，真对不起。”
content.fx.locked-in.oc.take-the-note.1.narrate: “我把曲柄把手挂在玫瑰区的日晷上，这样它就不会乱跑。把它装到迷宫远端那座高耸浅色门塔的绞盘上，然后转动：门会打开，旧桥会升起，跨过迷宫，直通瞭望塔。”
content.fx.locked-in.oc.take-the-note.2.narrate: “还有，走路轻一点。绿区的井下面睡着一个古老的东西，脚步声会把它吵醒。它要是醒了，就蹲下。钟声能引开它的注意。——雷恩”
content.fx.out.oc.wind-the-gate.7.narrate: 链条在你的头顶上方绷紧。门塔顶端，一座木板桥升起，越过迷宫，伸向瞭望塔顶的平台。此刻在平台上的人可以走过去了。
content.fx.the-watch.oc.read-the-bell-card.0.nar: 钟。每个按钮都挂在一块标明其区域颜色的牌子下，玫瑰色、黄色、蓝色或绿色，按下就会敲响那个区域的钟。每口钟敲三下，每一下之间要等钟声静下来。沉睡者只是在听的时候，钟声能引它转头；可它一旦追起人来，什么钟都引不开它。
content.fx.trig.shut-onto-the-bridge.0.narrate: 桥用铁链吊在这根柱子上。闸门绞开后，桥就会放下来。
content.npc.wren.name: 雷恩·阿普尔盖特
content.obj.locked-in.take-the-note.hint: 在长椅旁的桶里，瞭望塔脚下。
content.obj.locked-in.take-the-note.title: 取走桶里的纸条
content.obj.out.meet-wren.title: 与雷恩交谈
content.obj.out.reach-the-gate-tower.hint: 迷宫远端那座高高的白塔，过了黄区就是。
content.obj.out.reach-the-gate-tower.title: 前往门塔
content.obj.out.wind-the-gate.answers.done: 大门已经打开了。出去吧。
content.obj.out.wind-the-gate.answers.missing_it: 手持曲柄才能装到绞盘上。
content.obj.out.wind-the-gate.answers.not_yet: 绞盘没有柄。曲柄挂在玫瑰区的日晷上。
content.obj.out.wind-the-gate.hint: 大门旁的绞盘。手持曲柄。
content.obj.out.wind-the-gate.title: 把曲柄装到绞盘上摇动
content.obj.the-crank.find-the-sundial.hint: 在玫瑰铺地区的一个小圆庭院里。
content.obj.the-crank.find-the-sundial.title: 找到日晷
content.obj.the-crank.take-the-crank.title: 取走曲柄手柄
content.obj.the-watch.climb-the-tower.hint: 沿着中心塔内的梯子上去。
content.obj.the-watch.climb-the-tower.title: 登上瞭望塔
content.obj.the-watch.read-the-bell-card.answers: 玫瑰、黄、蓝、绿：四区的钟各对应一个按钮。
一本讲敲钟的书。等离开小路再看也不迟。
content.obj.the-watch.read-the-bell-card.hint: 在塔顶平台上，四个按钮旁边。
content.obj.the-watch.read-the-bell-card.title: 阅读书架上的敲钟手册
content.quest.locked-in.goal: 从迷宫中央长椅旁的桶里取出园丁的纸条，读读大门为什么关着。
content.quest.out.goal: 在门塔用曲柄把大门摇开，然后走到草地上的园丁那里。
content.quest.the-crank.goal: 在玫瑰区找到日晷，从上面取走大门的曲柄手柄，古井就会苏醒。
content.quest.the-watch.goal: 爬上瞭望塔，在平台上阅读鸣钟手册，弄清哪个按钮敲响哪口钟。
content.trigger.ring-blue-bell.answers.not_yet: 没有反应：蓝钟还在摆动，或者它已经敲完最后一响。
content.trigger.ring-green-bell.answers.not_yet: 没有反应：绿钟还在摆动，或者它已经敲完最后一响。
content.trigger.ring-rose-bell.answers.not_yet: 没有反应：玫瑰钟还在摆动，或者它已经敲完最后一响。
content.trigger.ring-yellow-bell.answers.not_yet: 没有反应：黄钟还在摆动，或者它已经敲完最后一响。
content.trigger.shut-onto-the-bridge.answers.don: 铁链松了。桥已经放下来了。
content.world.title: 静谧花园

source.class.caller.blurb: For the watchtower: a spyglass to see the lanes, and eggs and a bow to draw the sleeper away from your friend.
source.class.caller.name: Caller
source.class.runner.blurb: Light feet for the lanes: run for the far gate, and creep when the garden goes quiet.
source.class.runner.kit.1.name: Soft-soled Boots
source.class.runner.name: Runner
source.dlg.wren.wren-alone.opt.0.label: What was that thing?
source.dlg.wren.wren-alone.opt.1.label: I'll wait for them.
source.dlg.wren.wren-alone.opt.2.label: Just me tonight.
source.dlg.wren.wren-alone.text: Oh! You're out! I wound that gate with you inside, didn't I. I'm so sorry. Is there anyone else in there? If someone's up the watchtower, the bridge is up now: they can walk over the top of the maze, if they've the nerve.
source.dlg.wren.wren-thing-alone.opt.0.label: I'll wait for them.
source.dlg.wren.wren-thing-alone.opt.1.label: Just me tonight.
source.dlg.wren.wren-thing-alone.text: The Listener. It sleeps under the old well and hears every footstep in the maze. We gardeners walk softly and wind the gate at dusk, and it sleeps. Tonight it didn't.
source.dlg.wren.wren-thing.opt.0.label: We made it.
source.dlg.wren.wren-thing.text: The Listener. It sleeps under the old well and hears every footstep in the maze. We gardeners walk softly and wind the gate at dusk, and it sleeps. Tonight it didn't. Tomorrow I'm hanging a bell at the gate as well.
source.dlg.wren.wren-together.opt.0.label: What was that thing?
source.dlg.wren.wren-together.opt.1.label: We made it.
source.dlg.wren.wren-together.text: Oh! Oh, you're out, both of you! I wound that gate with you inside, didn't I. And you came over the bridge? Nobody's walked that bridge in thirty summers. I'm so sorry. I was frightened just watching you come over it.
source.fx.locked-in.oc.take-the-note.0.narrate: "Closing! Gate wound shut. If you're reading this you're locked in, and I'm so sorry."
source.fx.locked-in.oc.take-the-note.1.narrate: "I hang the crank handle on the sundial in the rose quarter, so it never walks off. Fit it to the winch in the gate tower, the tall pale one at the far edge of the maze, and wind: the gate opens, and the old bridge comes up across the maze to the watchtower."
source.fx.locked-in.oc.take-the-note.2.narrate: "And walk softly. Something old sleeps under the well in the green quarter, and it wakes to footsteps. If it's up, crouch. A bell will turn its head. — Wren"
source.fx.out.oc.wind-the-gate.7.narrate: Chains run tight over your head. Up on the gate tower's top a plank bridge swings up and reaches across the maze to the watchtower's deck. Whoever is up on the deck can walk across it now.
source.fx.the-watch.oc.read-the-bell-card.0.nar: THE BELLS. Each button sits under a sign of its quarter's colour, rose, yellow, blue or green, and rings that quarter's bell. Three rings to a bell, and let it settle between rings. A bell turns the sleeper's head while it is only listening; once it is chasing someone, no bell will turn it.
source.fx.trig.cross-the-bridge.1.narrate: The planks hold. Don't look down.
source.fx.trig.ring-blue-bell.3.narrate: Far below, the blue bell rings.
source.fx.trig.ring-green-bell.3.narrate: Far below, the green bell rings.
source.fx.trig.ring-rose-bell.3.narrate: Far below, the rose bell rings.
source.fx.trig.ring-yellow-bell.3.narrate: Far below, the yellow bell rings.
source.fx.trig.shut-onto-the-bridge.0.narrate: The bridge is chained up from this post. It comes down when the gate is wound.
source.npc.wren.name: Wren Applegate

A book of bell-ringing. It can wait until you are out of the lanes.

source.quest.locked-in.goal: Take the gardener's note from the barrel by the bench at the heart of the maze and read why the gate is shut.
source.quest.out.goal: Wind the great gate open with the crank at the gate tower, then walk out to the gardener in the meadow.
source.quest.the-crank.goal: Find the sundial in the rose quarter and take the gate's crank handle from it, and the old well wakes.
source.quest.the-watch.goal: Climb the watchtower and read the bell book on the deck, to learn which button rings which bell.
